title: Telephone area codes
description: Paraguayan landline area codes (0X XX XXX XXX) can be used for region guessing: the first digit indicates the region (e.g. 2 near Asunción, 3 north-east, 4 the Chaco, 5 centre, 6 east, 7 south/Itapúa, 8 Misiones/Ñeembucú). Mobile numbers start with 09; international code +595.

title: PY09 with a frontage road (Asunción–Villa Choferes)
description: The PY09 is one of the very few highways driving north-west, with a Formosa vibe (Caranday palms, low bushy trees). If there is a frontage road you are between Asunción and Villa Choferes (near Loma Plata). North-west of Pozo Colorado the frontage road is always to the north; south-east of it, it alternates south / north / south into Asunción.

title: PY09 north-west of Villa Choferes: no frontage road
description: North-west of Villa Choferes the PY09 never has a frontage road: a plain highway driving north-west through undeveloped, bushy country — nearly unique in Paraguay.

title: PY09 far north-west: unpaved
description: At the far north-western end of its coverage the PY09 is unpaved, and narrower near the very end.

title: Monk parakeet nests on poles (PY09 near Villa Choferes)
description: Just north-west of Villa Choferes, up to Mariscal Estigarribia, the poles along the PY09 carry big bird nests (monk parakeets).

title: PY16 north of the PY09: driving north, unpaved
description: North of its intersection with the PY09, the PY16 drives north and is unpaved — a rare combo in Paraguay. Often organ-pipe cacti; sometimes a strong front haze from the low sun.

title: PY16 south of Filadelfia: stormy sky
description: South of Filadelfia the PY16 has stormy skies, sometimes rain or a wet road. Unpaved and driving south only south of Neuland; mostly paved, both directions, from Neuland to Filadelfia.

title: Ruta Bioceánica (PY15): driving east with a front blur
description: The Bioceánica roads drive almost due east with a front blur and an undeveloped western vibe. The western stretch feels cramped with trees close to the road (sometimes organ-pipe cacti); the eastern stretch towards Carmelo Peralta is more open, with Formosa palms.

title: PY06: undented truck driving north through farmland
description: The PY06 runs north/south through soybean and corn country south of the PY02, driven north with a generic darker grey (undented) truck. More overcast and developed towards the PY02, sunnier and more agricultural to the south.

title: PY07 north of the PY02: dented truck driving north
description: The PY07 was driven with the dented light-silver truck. North of the PY02 it drives north, with a front blur; with farmland and a N/S road angle, it is the PY07.

title: PY07 south of the PY02: dented truck driving south
description: The PY07 was driven with the dented light-silver truck. South of the PY02 it drives south through farmland.

title: PY03: dented truck driving east/west
description: The PY03 has the dented truck all the way from Asunción to the Brazilian border — practically the only east/west highway with it. It mostly drives east, but drives west on the section nearest Brazil; more agricultural towards Brazil, more grazing towards Asunción.

title: PY21 east: farmland, driving west into the sun
description: The eastern, agricultural PY21 drives west towards the sun (covered in the afternoon). The PY10 looks identical but drives west with the sun behind (morning coverage). '21 rhymes with sun.' Part of it is cobblestone, often covered in sand.

title: PY21 west: grazing, driving east, low western sun
description: The western PY21 drives east through grazing land and macaw palms, with the sun low in the west behind the truck. Only the PY21 and a bit of the PY22 (which has a follow car) drive east with the sun this close to setting.

title: PY10 east: farmland, driving west with the sun behind
description: The eastern, agricultural PY10 drives west with the sun to the east, behind the truck (morning coverage) — unlike the PY21, which drives into the sun. The farmland vibe ends around the Guairá/Caazapá department border.

title: PY18 far east: deep red soil on the road
description: The PY18 always drives east. At its far eastern end, between the PY06 and the PY07, deep red soil covers the road and partly hides the pavement.

title: PY18 east: farmland and exposed red soil banks
description: The eastern PY18 runs through farmland, and its whole eastern half has exposed red banks of soil along the road — never west of its midpoint.

title: PY18 west: grazing land, driving east into the sun
description: West of the farmland the PY18 is grazing land with eucalyptus plantations, driven east into the sun (very low and bright out west). Sizeable hills are visible in the middle section, e.g. Cerro Acahay.

title: PY18 Asunción–Carapeguá: dented truck, smoky sky
description: From Asunción to Carapeguá the PY18 was driven south-east by the dented truck, in hazy coverage from the October 2024 forest fires.

title: PY02 west of Caaguazú: solid outer lines
description: The PY02, the divided highway from Asunción to Ciudad del Este, has solid white outer lines west of the town of Caaguazú.

title: PY02 east of Caaguazú: dashed rectangle outer lines
description: East of the town of Caaguazú, the PY02 has Denmark-like dashed rectangles as outer lines.

title: PY19: driving north-east through Formosa-like floodplain
description: The PY19 runs along the Paraguay River floodplain: wet, long dense grass, short bushy trees and Formosa palms. Driving north-east with this vibe is the PY19.

title: PY20: unpaved, driving east, macaw palms
description: The PY20 drives east along the Paraná, very flat, mostly unpaved, with lots of macaw (Paraguay) palms; its western portion has hexagonal paving.

title: PY20 north of Ayolas: forest fire haze
description: Coming out of Ayolas the PY20 turns north, with very obvious forest-fire coverage — unique on a highway like this.

title: PY08 south of the PY02: heavily blurred truck
description: The PY08 (south-driving part) looks like the PY01, but the blur covers much more of the truck ('the blur ate more of the truck on the 08'); never the dented truck. Hills only to the east in the middle of the country; eucalyptus near Caazapá.

title: PY08 north of the PY02: very straight road heading NNW
description: North of the PY02 the PY08 drives north on a very straight road with a consistent, slightly north-westerly angle; more open, cloudier and flatter further north.

title: PY01: lightly blurred truck, hills in Paraguarí
description: The PY01 (Asunción–Encarnación) mostly drives south. Less of the truck is blurred than on the PY08 (you can see the roof grooves, even the antenna). Hills in several directions point to Paraguarí department or near Santa Rosa.

title: PY22 south of Concepción: follow car
description: The southern half of the PY22 (Concepción to San Estanislao) has a follow truck with a camera mount, sometimes behind, sometimes ahead. Includes an unpaved, agricultural middle section.

title: PY22 north of Concepción: Formosa palms, driving SE
description: North of Concepción the PY22 drives south-east with no follow car, often near the Paraguay River (Formosa palms). Formosa palms with big hills: the far north, near Vallemí.

title: PY13 south of the PY21: north-driving under dark overcast skies
description: The PY13 drives north through grazing land. Its southern half (south of the PY21) is the most overcast, with dark skies: a north-driving road under dark cloud is the southern PY13.

title: PY11 west of the PY08: driving west into a low sun
description: West of the PY08 the PY11 drives west towards a low western sun, through grazing, wetland or generic country (Formosa palms near the Paraguay River).

title: PY11 east of the PY08: driving east, macaw palms
description: East of the PY08 the PY11 drives east through vast open fields full of macaw palms, generally cloudy, with some wilder farmland near the Brazilian border.

title: Orange roof inserts on the truck (PY05)
description: Along the whole PY05 the rubber inserts on the sides of the truck roof are so dirty they look orange. They exist elsewhere, but orange inserts should make you think of the PY05.

title: PY05 east: mountains with exposed red cliffs
description: In the east, towards Pedro Juan Caballero, the PY05 has striking mountains with exposed red cliffs.

title: PY05 west of the Paraguay River: Formosa vibe, driving west
description: West of the Paraguay River the PY05 looks like Formosa and drives due west (the PY04 also does, but has a black front smudge).

title: PY04: black front smudge, driving west
description: The covered part of the PY04 has Formosa vibes and drives west with a noticeable black front smudge, fainter to the east and stronger to the west.
